Morgan (AcmeSec): Hi team — during our SIG form prep we noticed missing audit log entries for key unwraps between 2026-02-12 14:00-14:30 UTC and a bunch of 401s during the export. We need sample logs + repro steps to include in our response. Deadline Friday.
Jordan (CS): Thanks Morgan. Can you paste one example timestamp + request id? Even a short repro (curl) would help. We'll triage. :eyes:
Morgan (AcmeSec): request id: req_8f3a9d2c, time 2026-02-12T14:05:12Z. We ran the CAIQ export from the Console -> Security -> Exports and saw the UI hang, then some 401s in the audit UI.
Maria (Support): FYI I'm adding this to the bespoke questionnaire thread. Morgan — can you confirm if you used SSO or API token for the export? Also do you have an endpoint screenshot? :clipboard:
Morgan (AcmeSec): export initiated via API token (scoped to exports:read). Screenshot attached in the ticket — UI showed spinner, then a 401 toast.
Alex (Eng): Quick hypothesis: token scope + rotated key could yield 401s on the export job workers. Sam, can we check the keystore envelope unwrap logs around req_8f3a9d2c? kms-bot, can you pull KMS audit samples?
kms-bot: Requested KMS audit samples for req_8f3a9d2c. Returning 5 matching entries (keystore unwrap events).
Sam (Infra): Pasting the relevant trimmed lines below — looks like two unwrap attempts, second failed with HSM_STATUS=AUTH_ERROR.
```
2026-02-12T14:05:11Z req=8f3a9d2c module=keystore action=unwrap key_id=redwood-prod-01 result=ok
2026-02-12T14:05:12Z req=8f3a9d2c module=keystore action=unwrap key_id=redwood-prod-01 result=HSM_STATUS=AUTH_ERROR code=0x5b
2026-02-12T14:05:12Z req=8f3a9d2c module=exports action=start job_id=exp_9921 status=retry
2026-02-12T14:05:13Z req=8f3a9d2c module=exports action=complete job_id=exp_9921 status=failed error=auth_failure
```
Alex (Eng): That HSM_STATUS looks like the HSM rejected the unwrap due to a session auth failure, probably transient. Could be due to expired HSM session or auth proxy hiccup. Morgan, any recent KMS key rotations on your side or changes to allowed principals?
Morgan (AcmeSec): No key rotations. We do rotate API tokens daily. The token used was created yesterday.
Jordan (CS): Two tracks: (1) repro + evidence for CAIQ response (we need export attempt log + KMS audit snippet) (2) mitigation for immediate deadline — ask for a short extension and provide temporary workaround. Maria — can you request a 48-hour extension?
Maria (Support): Done — I emailed the customer portal reviewer and requested a 48h extension, explained we are collecting HSM audit evidence.
Alex (Eng): For reproducibility — run this sequence and attach stdout/stderr:```
# simulate export via API
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports -d '{"type":"security_questionnaire"}' -v
# tail the export worker logs and keystore audit stream
kubectl logs -l app=export-worker -n prod --since=10m
kubectl logs -l app=keystore -n prod --since=10m | grep unwrap | grep req_8f3a9d2c
```
Sam (Infra): Also check the HSM proxy logs for the session pool. If session auth fails you'll see repeated AUTH_ERROR with matching HSM_STATUS hex codes. I opened an infra ticket (INF-4627) to correlate sessions.
Jordan (CS): Morgan — if you can run Alex's curl with the same API token and attach the full raw response (including headers) that will help us confirm if 401 originates at the API gateway or deeper. If you can't run it, we can reproduce with a temp token.
Morgan (AcmeSec): Will try now and upload the raw response to the support ticket.
kms-bot: HSM attestation / cert chain for redwood-prod-01 is present; last rotation 2024-11-03. No full attestation gaps.
Alex (Eng): If we confirm transient HSM session auth, mitigation options: (A) retry logic bump for export workers, (B) rotate HSM session pool, (C) provide signed export bundle from storage as interim. Which do you prefer, Morgan?
Morgan (AcmeSec): (C) would be easiest for compliance reviewers — signed bundle + audit lines. We still need the KMS unwrap audit lines included in response.
Jordan (CS): Ok we will generate the signed bundle and include the trimmed KMS audit snippet and the export job logs. Maria — I'll need a short blurb to paste into the bespoke CAIQ answer explaining the failure and remediation. Keep it neutral: transient HSM session auth caused export worker to fail; we provided signed bundle and logs.
Maria (Support): Draft: "During the requested export timeframe, a subset of export worker requests encountered transient HSM session authentication failures, causing a small number of export attempts to fail with 401s. We have collected keystore audit logs, export worker logs, and provided a signed bundle to the customer. Ongoing remediation includes improving worker retry and HSM session pooling." Want me to send?
Morgan (AcmeSec): That's perfect. Please include the exact log snippets and job ids. Deadline extended by reviewer to Mar 1 COB. Thanks. :pray:
Sam (Infra): Marking INF-4627 as critical for follow-up and scheduling a short window to rotate session pool tomorrow 03:00 UTC.
Jordan (CS): Closing loop here — we'll attach artifacts to the portal ticket once Alex and Sam finish the bundle and session rotation. Morgan — ping if you need anything else. :white_check_mark:
